answer: A summit of per-task receipts records who did what, and the dune of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The atlas of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
